reason: DROPPED exists because a claim marked in several files fails open when only some markers go: the remaining ones still agree with each other, so nothing looks wrong while the file that lost its marker drifts unwatched. Don't fold this into OK or ORPHAN.
author: Claude
snippet:
return Result(name, claim, Status.DROPPED, markers, document=markers[0].value.raw,
              message=("the marker was removed from "
                       f"{', '.join(gone)}; it is still marked in {', '.join(here)}"),
              checked=checked, age=age)
